data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a gross reserve release of GBP 5.213 million for prior underwriting years 2019 and 2020, representing a 33.8% reduction in opening gross reserves. This favorable development is derived from the claims development table, indicating that the ultimate claims estimates for these prior years have reduced compared to previous projections.
raw_causal_phrases: Reserve adequacy is monitored through quarterly review by the Asta Actuarial team and the Reserving Committee.
The principal assumption underlying the liability estimates is that the future claims development will follow a similar pattern to past claims development experience.
data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development calculated from the gross claims development table on page 15 as no explicit prior year movement figure was stated in narrative or a dedicated note. The 'Change in claims outstanding' figure in the Income Statement and Technical Provisions note includes both current and prior year movements and was therefore not used.
